scope_note: Developer-side system definition only. It binds no blind cohort, authorizes no run, and must not be cited as an evaluation freeze. prospective-blind-v3 stands at 8/12 and remains custodian-sealed.

execution_graph_unique.detail: The whole chain runs offline: source -> evidence builder -> Raw LLM v2 -> frozen raw -> normalization -> evidence verifier -> scorer. agent.py exposes extract-raw, run-chain and score; CI runs all of them and asserts the raw artifact is unchanged afterwards.

raw_llm_definition_unique.detail: Raw is llm-extractor-v2 output, validated against raw-extraction-schema-v2 and frozen by tools/freeze_raw_predictions.py before anything downstream reads it. llm-extractor-v1 remains on the branch as LEGACY_NOT_USED.

verifier_unique.detail: evidence-verifier-v1.1 is the only verifier, it does not normalize, and its coverage is frozen in VERIFIER_COVERAGE_V1 with one mode per field. reaction stays NOT_CHECKED_V1 by policy.

field_schema_frozen.detail: benchmark/FIELD_SCHEMA_V1.json, 12 atomic fields, no aggregate conditions field, selectivity option B.

scoring_contract_frozen.detail: agent-v1-scorer-v2 reports four separate accounts with explicit denominators and no single verified accuracy.

prompt_frozen.detail: llm-extractor-prompt-v2 covers the 12 fields and the four abstention reasons; it is frozen as a candidate and any change creates llm-extractor-v3.

model_frozen.detail: Model gpt-5.6-sol, Responses API, strict JSON, reasoning effort medium, temperature and top_p null, seed unsupported. The OpenAI SDK version is still unresolved and no live call has been made.

runtime_captured.detail: requirements-benchmark-lock.txt pins the deterministic stack. The openai package is absent, and one interpreter version must be chosen for the benchmark environment.

cli_runnable.detail: agent.py extract-raw runs the chain as a dry run (request envelopes only) or as an offline replay; both are exercised in CI together with the freeze tool.

regression_tests_pass.detail: Local suite green on synthetic fixtures and manifest invariants; no development-set or blind data is executed in CI.

verifier_coverage_contract.detail: 11 of 12 fields have a verifier; reaction is explicitly excluded. catalyst and product accept only literal evidence and can never block; stereochemical_outcome reads explicit descriptors only. Coverage is reported as a rate over candidate x field units.

development_gold.detail: development-gold-field-schema-v1 exists for all 12 cases and 144 slots, but the populated legacy Gold artifact is unrecoverable, so only 15 slots are answered and 11 are source-reviewed not_reported. 118 slots still need a chemist's source pass and are excluded from every denominator. The freeze tool refuses to mark the Gold frozen while that is true.

blocking_gaps: 118 of 144 development Gold slots still need source adjudication; the populated legacy Gold v1 artifact is unrecoverable
FIELD_SCHEMA_V1 defines no controlled vocabulary for `reaction` (SCHEMA_DEFINITION_GAP), so its 12 Gold slots stay unadjudicated
3 of 12 Gold cases cannot be bound to an evidence-builder candidate chunk (CANDIDATE_BINDING_FAILURE)
OpenAI SDK exact version is not frozen
the benchmark Python runtime is not pinned to one interpreter version
no live provider call has been made against gpt-5.6-sol
chemical identity comparators are string-level only
validation_data_used: examples/raw_chain_sample.txt with examples/raw_llm_replay_example.jsonl (synthetic replay, no model call)
benchmark manifests committed in this repository

development_gold.lineage: legacy Gold v1 (8 fields) + source adjudication -> development Gold FIELD_SCHEMA_V1
